key_insight: Replace the current “on‑the‑fly” agent loop with an AI Workflow Store that encodes reusable, testable workflows and SE practices so personal agents can be engineered, tested, and deployed with predictable, robust behavior.
problem_solved: Addresses the absence of disciplined software engineering for personal agents—short‑circuited by real‑time plan synthesis—which causes brittleness, unsafe or unpredictable actions, and difficulty in testing, evaluation, and staged rollout.
method: Define and store declarative agent workflows and components (plans, prompts, checks) in a versioned AI Workflow Store for reuse and auditability.
Integrate testing, adversarial evaluation, and CI/CD style pipelines to validate workflows before deployment and support staged rollouts and monitoring.
Provide tooling for sandboxed execution, metrics collection, and automated rollback to enforce safety, reproducibility, and iterative improvement.
impact: Enables AI/ML teams to apply standard SE practices to agent development, improving reliability, safety, and reproducibility of personal agents while simplifying collaboration and deployment across environments.

paper_title: Engineering Robustness into Personal Agents with the AI Workflow Store
